scriptLines:
query: '
SELECT a.*
FROM bronze.admissions a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.patients p
    WHERE p.patient_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.patient_id)
)
AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), '') IS NOT NULL
',

department = case(     in(['cardio', 'cardiolgy', 'cardiology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Cardiology',     in(['onco', 'oncology', 'oncologyy'], lower(trim(department))), 'Oncology',     in(['neuro', 'neurology', 'nuerology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Neurology',     in(['emergancy', 'emergency', 'er'], lower(trim(department))), 'Emergency',     in(['gen surg', 'general surgery', 'generalsurgery'], lower(trim(department))), 'General Surgery',     in(['ortho', 'orthopaedics', 'orthopedics'], lower(trim(department))), 'Orthopedics',     in(['paediatrics', 'pediatrics', 'peds'], lower(trim(department))), 'Pediatrics',     trim(department) ),

admission_date = case(     isNull(admission_date) || trim(admission_date) == '',         toDate(null()),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(toInteger(right(trim(admission_date), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),                 right(trim(admission_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(admission_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(admission_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),      toDate(null()) ),

discharge_date = case(     isNull(discharge_date) || trim(discharge_date) == '',         toDate(null()),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(toInteger(right(trim(discharge_date), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),                 right(trim(discharge_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(discharge_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(discharge_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),      toDate(null()) )) ~> DRVAdmissions

DRVAdmissions derive(discharge_date = iif(     !isNull(discharge_date) &&     !isNull(admission_date) &&     discharge_date < admission_date,     toDate(null()),     discharge_date )) ~> DRVFechasValidas

sources.name: SRCBronzeBilling
sources.description:
SELECT b.*
FROM bronze.billing b
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.admissions a
    WHERE a.admission_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, b.admission_id)
)
AND TRY_CONVERT(
    DECIMAL(12,2),
    NULLIF(
        LTRIM(RTRIM(
            REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(b.amount, 'USD', ''), '$', ''), ',', '')
        )),
        ''
    )
) IS NOT NULL

scriptLines:
query: '
SELECT
    b.billing_id,
    b.admission_id,
    b.charge_type,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(40), x.importe) AS amount,
    b.payment_status,
    b.payment_date
FROM bronze.billing b
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TRY_CONVERT(
        DECIMAL(12,2),
        NULLIF(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(UPPER(b.amount), 'USD', ''),
                        '$', ''
                    ),
                    ',', ''
                )
            )),
            ''
        )
    ) AS importe
) x
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.admissions a
    WHERE a.admission_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, b.admission_id)
)
AND x.importe IS NOT NULL
',

payment_date = case(     isNull(payment_date) || trim(payment_date) == '',         toDate(null()),      regexMatch(trim(payment_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(trim(payment_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(payment_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(payment_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(payment_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(toInteger(right(trim(payment_date), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),                 right(trim(payment_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(payment_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(payment_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),      toDate(null()) )) ~> DRVBilling

query: '
SELECT d.*
FROM bronze.diagnoses d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.admissions a
    WHERE a.admission_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, d.admission_id)
)
',

severity = case(     lower(trim(severity)) == 'mild', 'Mild',     lower(trim(severity)) == 'moderate', 'Moderate',     lower(trim(severity)) == 'severe', 'Severe',     lower(trim(severity)) == 'critical', 'Critical',     severity )) ~> DRVDiagnoses
gender = case(     in(['m', 'male'], lower(trim(gender))), 'Male',     in(['f', 'female'], lower(trim(gender))), 'Female',     'Unknown' ),

insurance_provider = case(     isNull(insurance_provider) || in(['', 'n/a', 'none'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'No especificado',     in(['medicaid'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'Medicaid',     in(['medicare', 'medi-care'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'Medicare',     in(['cigna', 'cigna health'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'Cigna',     in(['aetna', 'aetna inc.', 'aetnaa'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'Aetna',     in(['bluecross', 'blue cross', 'blue-cross'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'Blue Cross',     in(['unitedhealth', 'united health', 'uhc'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'UnitedHealth',     in(['self pay', 'self-pay'], lower(trim(insurance_provider))), 'Self-Pay',     trim(insurance_provider) ),

date_of_birth = case(     isNull(date_of_birth) || trim(date_of_birth) == '',         toDate(null()),      regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(toInteger(right(trim(date_of_birth), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),                 right(trim(date_of_birth), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(date_of_birth), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(date_of_birth), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),      toDate(null()) )) ~> DRVPatients

query: '
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(department)) AS nombre_departamento
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(department)), '') IS NOT NULL
',

query: '
SELECT
    patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    full_name AS nombre_completo,
    gender AS genero,
    date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CASE
        WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL
          OR date_of_birth > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
            THEN NULL
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '0-17'
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '18-29'
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -45, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '30-44'
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -60, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '45-59'
        ELSE '60+'
    END AS rango_etario,
    email AS correo_electronico,
    address AS direccion,
    insurance_provider AS proveedor_seguro
FROM silver.patients
',

query: '
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(icd_code)) AS codigo_icd,
    diagnosis_description AS descripcion_patologia,
    ISNULL(severity, 'No especificado') AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
',

query: '
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(charge_type)) AS tipo_cargo,
    UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(payment_status))) AS estado_pago
FROM silver.billing
',

query: '
SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), f.fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
    f.fecha AS fecha_completa,

    CAST(YEAR(f.fecha) AS INT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha)) AS trimestre_nombre,

    CAST(MONTH(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,
    CHOOSE(
        MONTH(f.fecha),
        'Enero', 'Febrero', 'Marzo', 'Abril',
        'Mayo', 'Junio', 'Julio', 'Agosto',
        'Septiembre', 'Octubre', 'Noviembre', 'Diciembre'
    ) AS mes_nombre,

    CHOOSE(
        MONTH(f.fecha),
        'Ene', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Abr',
        'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Ago',
        'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dic'
    ) AS mes_corto,

    CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,

    d.dia_iso AS dia_semana,
    CHOOSE(
        d.dia_iso,
        'Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles',
        'Jueves', 'Viernes', 'Sábado', 'Domingo'
    ) AS dia_nombre,

    CAST(
        CASE WHEN d.dia_iso IN (6, 7)
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS BIT
    ) AS es_fin_de_semana

FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha
    FROM silver.admissions
    WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT discharge_date AS fecha
    FROM silver.admissions
    WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT payment_date AS fecha
    FROM silver.billing
    WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) AS f

CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT CAST(
        (DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.fecha) % 7) + 1
        AS TINYINT
    ) AS dia_iso
) AS d
',

query: '
SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,

    CASE
        WHEN d.diagnosis_id IS NULL
            THEN sd.diagnostico_key
        ELSE gd.diagnostico_key
    END AS diagnostico_key,

    fi.fecha_key AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    fa.fecha_key AS fecha_alta_key,

    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,

    DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        a.admission_date,
        a.discharge_date
    ) AS dias_estancia,

    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones

FROM silver.admissions a

INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id_bk

INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON a.department = dep.nombre_departamento

INNER JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi
    ON a.admission_date = fi.fecha_completa

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa
    ON a.discharge_date = fa.fecha_completa

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        diagnosis_id,
        admission_id,
        icd_code,
        diagnosis_description,
        severity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY admission_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM silver.diagnoses
) d
    ON a.admission_id = d.admission_id
    AND d.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico gd
    ON gd.codigo_icd = LTRIM(RTRIM(d.icd_code))
    AND (
        gd.descripcion_patologia = d.diagnosis_description
        OR (
            gd.descripcion_patologia IS NULL
            AND d.diagnosis_description IS NULL
        )
    )
    AND gd.nivel_severidad =
        ISNULL(d.severity, 'No especificado')

CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT diagnostico_key
    FROM gold.dim_diagnostico
    WHERE codigo_icd = 'SIN-DIAG'
) sd
',

query: '
SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,
    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,

    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,
    s.servicio_cargo_key,

    f.fecha_key AS fecha_pago_key,

    b.amount AS monto_facturado,

    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_transacciones

FROM silver.billing b

INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
    ON b.admission_id = a.admission_id

INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id_bk

INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON a.department = dep.nombre_departamento

INNER JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo s
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(b.charge_type)) = s.tipo_cargo
    AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status))) = s.estado_pago

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha f
    ON b.payment_date = f.fecha_completa
',
